{{Quote|I get to watch you die from the comfort of the ''Deyvus''!|[[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Terror on the Twilight" />}}
The '''''Deyvus''''' was a merchant [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] used as a trap for [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
